body.description: Doña Inés, a thin young mother who lives in the Cellars under the old houses: black hair in a long braid, a faded mustard-yellow blouse with rolled sleeves, a long brown skirt, a dish towel over one shoulder, worried tired face. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
